# Introduction

This Rmarkdown file is part of the
[**CommuteCA**](https://github.com/dias-bruno/CommuteCA) package.
This package was created in conjunction with the office of the
[*Research Data Center* at *McMaster
University*](https://rdc.mcmaster.ca/), the [*Sherman Centre for Digital
Scholarship*](https://scds.ca/) and the [*Mobilizing
Justice*](https://mobilizingjustice.ca/)[^1].

[^1]: The Mobilizing Justice project is a multidisciplinary and
    multi-sector collaboration with the objective of understand and
    address transportation poverty in Canada and to improve the
    well-being of Canadians at risk of transport poverty. The Social
    Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSRHC) has provided
    funding for the project, which was created by an unprecedented
    alliance of academics from various Canadian provinces and
    institutions, transportation firms, and nonprofit organizations

The [**CommuteCA**](https://github.com/dias-bruno/CommuteCA) R
package was created to develop standardized methods for transport
analysis in research, particularly for analysis using the [*2021 Census of
Population*](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/index-eng.cfm) from Statistics Canada. We focused our efforts on the [_Commuting Reference Guide_](https://www12.statcan.gc.ca/census-recensement/2021/ref/98-500/011/98-500-x2021011-eng.cfm),
which provides valuable variables and information on commuting for the Canadian population aged 15 and older living in private households. 

After obtaining the accessibility measures for our study area, in this
`R` Markdown we will visualize the measure in form of maps.

## Suggested Readings

For plotting maps, we will mostly use the [`tmap`](https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/index.html) Package, which was made specifically for drawing thematic maps with `R`. This library was created based on [`ggplot2`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/), a package that we previously investigated in the exploratory data analysis template.

Although we have created this code to plot the maps, it is possible that the dimensions and positions of the scalebar and compass (north arrow) might need to be updated for your study area, since it is not possible to know the best position considering all possibilities of study area boundaries. Therefore, we strongly suggest that you read the  [`tmap`](https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/index.html) documentation. More specifically, the functions:

- scalebar: https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/reference/tm_scalebar.html
- compass: https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/reference/tm_compass.html

In addition, if you are interested in learning more about plotting maps with [`tmap`](https://r-tmap.github.io/tmap/index.html), we recommend you to read: 

-   Tennekes M., Nowosad J. (2025) Spatial Data Visualization with tmap: A Practical Guide to Thematic Mapping in R. Available at: https://tmap.geocompx.org

# Let's code!

Load the packages:

```{r load-packages}
library('CommuteCA') # Access datasets and functions from CommuteCA R package
library(dplyr)# A Grammar of Data Manipulation 
library(ggplot2) # Create Elegant Data Visualizations Using the Grammar of Graphics
library(RColorBrewer) # Color schemes for maps (and other graphics) designed
library(scales) # for scaling data
library(sf) # Support for simple features, a standardized way to encode spatial vector data
library(tmap) # Thematic maps
library(tidyr) # tidying data
library(readr) # Read csv files setting column data types
library('here') # enable easy file referencing in project-oriented workflows
```

## Data

The data used in this R markdown is the output of the previous `R`
markdown, in which we calculated accessibility and spatial availability
for our study area. The methodology described here is applicable to the
results obtained through the synthetic or original census survey.
Additionally, we will use the dissemination areas (DA) geometry to plot maps of the study area.

## Vetting observations 

Maps should follow the same rules for tabular output in that each geographic region in the map must contain the
minimum number of respondents and meet all applicable vetting guidelines. Data users should check that there is no
"geographical slivering" from omitted geographical areas that would result in a residual confidentiality issue (where the
subtraction of all releasable geographic areas from the total would identify the omitted geographic areas). For this reason, we will only use already tables released by the RDC to produce all the following maps. 

Setting the folder with the accessibility measures: 

```{r}
code <- "PCD3520"
measures_folder <- paste0(here::here(),"/data-raw/output/", code, "/DA/accessibility-measures/release/")
```


```{r reading-tables}
accessibilities_mode <- read.csv(paste0(measures_folder, 
                                        "accessibilities_mode_release.csv"))
accessibilities_general <- read.csv(paste0(measures_folder, 
                                           "accessibilities_general_release.csv"))
SA_mode_active <- read.csv(paste0(measures_folder, 
                             "SA_mode_active_release.csv"), fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
```

Reading the DA geometries:
```{r}
# Update this address if necessary
directory_spatial_files <- paste0(here(), "/data-raw/output/", code, "/spatial-files/") 
dissemination_areas <- st_read(paste0(directory_spatial_files, "dissemination_areas.gpkg"))
```

Reading the census_divisions geometries:

```{r}
census_divisions <-   st_read(paste0(directory_spatial_files, "census_divisions.gpkg"))
```

Creating a directory to export the figures:

```{r directory-export}
# Update the address to export the data, if necessary
diretorio_export_figures <- paste0(here(),"/data-raw/output/",code,"/DA/accessibility-figures/") 

if(!dir.exists(diretorio_export_figures)){
  dir.create(diretorio_export_figures, recursive = TRUE)}
```


# Total labour force

The accessibility tables contain measures by census tract, while the
mapping functions (from `tmap`) also need the geographic geometry of each dissemination area.

We therefore combine the attribute tables with the `sf` geometry
before creating the maps. Building the dataframe to produce the maps:

```{r}
names(dissemination_areas)[1] <- "PRCDDA" 
  
# General population
metrics <- dissemination_areas %>% 
  mutate(PRCDDA = as.numeric(PRCDDA)) %>%
  left_join(accessibilities_general, by = "PRCDDA") %>% 
  rename(HT = HT_i, 
         SA = SA_i, 
         SA_pp = SA_pp_i) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("HT","SA","SA_pp"), 
               names_to = "Measure", 
               values_to = "Value") %>% 
  mutate(Measure_labels = case_when(
    Measure == "HT" ~ "Gravity-based",
    Measure == "SA" ~ "Spatial availability",
    Measure == "SA_pp" ~ "Spatial availability per person"))

metrics_sf <- st_as_sf(metrics, crs = st_crs(dissemination_areas))
```

## Accessibility maps

We now map the three general accessibility measures. Then, we will separate maps to make it easier to understand how the spatial pattern changes depending on the definition of accessibility.


```{r}
total_HT_SA_SApp <- metrics_sf %>% 
  filter(Measure %in% c("HT","SA","SA_pp")) %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
             fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(value.na = "grey50", n = 5),
             style = "quantile", 
             fill.free = TRUE,
             border.col = NULL,
             palette = "YlOrRd", 
             title = "Accessibility") + 
  tm_facets_vstack("Measure_labels") + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"), color.dark = "grey30" )+
  tm_compass(position = c("left", "top"), size = 0.8)

tmap_save(total_HT_SA_SApp, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"total_HT_SA_SApp.jpg"), 
          width = 14, 
          height = 16, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/total_HT_SA_SApp.jpg"))
```

Hansen type: 

```{r}
HT_general <- metrics_sf %>% 
  filter(Measure == "HT") %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(value.na = "grey50", n = 5),
              style = "quantile", 
              border.col = NULL,
              palette = "BuPu", 
              title = "Gravity-based accessibility") + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out(), color.dark = "grey30")+
  tm_compass(position = c("Left", "Top"), size = 0.8)

tmap_save(HT_general, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"HT_general.jpg"), 
          width = 16, 
          height = 8, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/HT_general.jpg"))
```

# Labour force by transportaion mode 

Now, we will create maps to help us to visualize how accessibility varies by transportation mode. 

Building the dataframe to produce the maps: 

```{r}
accessibilities_mode$PRCDDA <- as.character(accessibilities_mode$PRCDDA)

# 4 transportation modes
four_mode_metrics <- 
  expand.grid(PRCDDA = unique(dissemination_areas$PRCDDA), 
              PwMode_label = unique(accessibilities_mode$PwMode_label)) %>%
  left_join(dissemination_areas, by = "PRCDDA") %>% 
  left_join(accessibilities_mode, by = c("PRCDDA", "PwMode_label")) %>% 
  rename(HT = HT_im, 
         SA = SA_im, 
         SA_pp = SA_pp_im) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("HT","SA","SA_pp"), 
               names_to = "Measure", 
               values_to = "Value") %>% 
  mutate(Measure_labels = case_when(
    Measure == "HT" ~ "Gravity-based",
    Measure == "SA" ~ "Spatial availability",
    Measure == "SA_pp" ~ "Spatial availability per person"), 
    PwMode_label = factor(PwMode_label, 
                       levels = c("Walk","Bike",
                                  "Public transit", "Car-motorized")))

four_mode_metrics_sf <- st_as_sf(four_mode_metrics,
                          crs = st_crs(dissemination_areas))
```

Building the dataframe to produce the maps: 

```{r}
SA_mode_active$PRCDDA <- as.character(SA_mode_active$PRCDDA)

# 3 transportation modes
three_mode_metrics <- 
  expand.grid(PRCDDA = unique(dissemination_areas$PRCDDA), 
              PwMode_label = unique(SA_mode_active$PwMode_label)) %>%
  left_join(dissemination_areas, by = "PRCDDA") %>% 
  left_join(SA_mode_active, by = c("PRCDDA", "PwMode_label")) %>% 
  rename(SA = SA_im, 
         SA_pp = SA_pp_im) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("SA","SA_pp"), 
               names_to = "Measure", 
               values_to = "Value") %>% 
  mutate(Measure_labels = case_when(
    Measure == "SA" ~ "Spatial availability",
    Measure == "SA_pp" ~ "Spatial availability per person"), 
    PwMode_label = factor(PwMode_label, 
                       levels = c("Active",
                                  "Public transit", "Car-motorized")))

three_mode_metrics_sf <- st_as_sf(three_mode_metrics,
                          crs = st_crs(dissemination_areas))
```

## Accessibility maps by modes: walking, cycling, public transit, and car-motorized

```{r}
four_mode_HT_SA_SApp <- four_mode_metrics_sf %>% 
  filter(Measure %in% c("HT","SA","SA_pp")) %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
             fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(value.na = "grey50", n = 5),
             style = "quantile", 
             fill.free = c(FALSE, TRUE),
             border.col = NULL,
             palette = "YlOrRd", 
             title = "Accessibility") + 
  tm_facets_grid(rows = "PwMode_label", columns = "Measure_labels") + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("Right","Bottom"), breaks = c(0,5,10), color.dark = "grey30" )+
  tm_compass(position = c("Left", "Top"), size = 1.5, text.size = 0.5, show.labels = FALSE)

tmap_save(four_mode_HT_SA_SApp, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"four_mode_HT_SA_SApp.jpg"), 
          width = 15, 
          height = 20, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 600)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/four_mode_HT_SA_SApp.jpg"))
```

Hansen type: 

```{r}
HT_four_mode <- four_mode_metrics_sf %>% 
  filter(Measure %in% c("HT")) %>% 
  tm_shape() + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "Value",
             fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(value.na = "grey50", n = 5),
             style = "quantile", 
             border.col = NULL,
             palette = "BuPu", 
             title = "Gravity-based accessibility") + 
  tm_facets_wrap("PwMode_label", ncol = 2) + 
  tm_shape(census_divisions) +
  tm_borders("black", lwd=0.5) + 
  tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out(), color.dark = "grey30")+
  tm_compass(position = c("Left", "Top"), size = 0.8)


tmap_save(HT_four_mode, 
          paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"HT_four_mode.jpg"), 
          width = 18, 
          height = 14, 
          units = "cm", 
          dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0(diretorio_export_figures,"/HT_four_mode.jpg"))
```
